name: Marking Your Body
overview: Scripture clearly instructs believers not to mark their bodies with cuttings or printed marks, as stated in Leviticus 19:28, reflecting God's holiness and the distinctiveness He calls His people to uphold. However, with the coming of Christ, who fulfills the law for righteousness (Romans 10:4), believers are called to a higher standard rooted in faith and godliness (Titus 1:1). Deliberate sin, including disregarding God's commands after knowing the truth, carries serious consequences, as Hebrews 10:26 warns, underscoring the importance of obedience in the believer's walk.
